text: A control stated in prose that nothing computes (round-comparison, disposition gate, fix-pinning) was the shape behind every review-loop failure measured in the aix-platform field study; backported to templates 2026-08-30

the promotion rubric's fourth criterion compares a catch rate against a false-positive cost, and nothing computes either: the numbers exist only inside an enforcer at the moment it enforces, which is why retire.md names the same absence twice — a rule that loads and is violated anyway, and a denial that never resolves to the rule that refused it
